title: Monthly Treasury Statement (Nov 2026 data) — the monthly deficit print
source: EST: fiscaldata.treasury.gov/static-data/published-reports/mts/MonthlyTreasuryStatement_202511.pdf, re-downloaded direct (HTTP 200) and text-extracted with `pdftotext -layout` on 2026-09-08. Its annual table reads verbatim 'Listed below are the scheduled release dates for the Monthly Treasury Statement. The Statement is released at 2:00 p.m.' with the row 'November 2026 / December 10, 2026'. Corroborated by the 8th-federal-workday rule this calendar validated 20-of-20 against Treasury's published 2024 and 2026 schedules, which computes 2026-12-10 exactly. Primary-sourced, but filed estimate per the event-research lane's no-self-confirm limit on an event discovered in-sweep — the same grounds on which mts-october-2026-11-12 was first filed before its own session promoted it. Checked 2026-09-08
notes: The third MTS this calendar has dated, and the one that makes the other two legible. Treasury's own table skips the September-2026 accounting month entirely — footnote (1), 'Release date subject to completion of year-end reporting requirements' — so the series runs 09-11, then 11-12 (Oct data), then this. It earns a row on a point neither sibling can make: 2026-12-10 COLLIDES with the already-tracked cpi-2026-12-10 at 08:30 ET, which is exactly the contamination that forced mts-august-2026-09-11 to register its market-impact forward test (FT-51) against 11-12 rather than its own date. Dating 12-10 is what turns 'two of the next four MTS releases collide with CPI' from an assertion into two calendar rows a reader can check, and it pre-empts the next lane re-deriving the same table. It also sits one session ahead of the 2026-12-11 CR expiry and government-funding deadline already tracked, so a funding lapse would hit this release's schedule before any other MTS in the window - FT-50 and FT-51 both carry an explicit 'void if the release slips or is truncated by a funding lapse' clause, and this is the edition where that clause is most likely to bite. Not a tradeable print: symbols: [], no house playbook is macro-keyed, and the sibling ledger's measurement is that this release does not move the tape (56 releases: TLT p=0.249, SPY p=0.689; 35 intraday 13:30->close windows: TLT p=0.413, SPY p=0.946, SPY window sigma BELOW its all-day base). Tiered medium to match mts-august-2026-09-11 and mts-october-2026-11-12. Discovered during the mts-august-2026-09-11 pulse-check adjacency sweep (2026-09-08); proposed, not confirmed, and it needs its own never-assessed research session before anything is claimed about the November-data print itself.
